graded_by: loop operator (Claude Code) viewing the rendered PNG
note: Visual checklist from PROJECT_SPEC Section 7. These are judgments over the render; the computable subset is cross-checked numerically in grade.py so a visual pass cannot ride on a bad silhouette.

checklist.item: Silhouette: rounded outer/grip edge, straight inner split edge, reads as a hand grip
checklist.note: D-profile: flat inner (cyan mating edge) + bowed rounded outer. Reads as a grip.

checklist.item: Mirror: left is a true mirror of right
checklist.note: Confirmed visually and numerically (F3 max err 0.000mm).

checklist.item: Key field: 25 keys/half, i8+-like QWERTY, no overlaps
checklist.note: Left reads 1-5/QWERT/ASDFG/ZXCVB; right 67890/YUIOP/HJKL-ENT/NM,./ + arrows. No overlaps.

checklist.item: Thumb ergonomics: every key within a plausible thumb arc from the grip anchor
checklist.note: Arc 22-84mm from bottom-outer anchor; actual key radii 36.3-80.6mm (F4).

checklist.item: Backbone interface: inner edge exposes >=2 mount bosses + flat mating reference
checklist.note: 2 inner-edge M2 holes + flat inner edge marked as mating reference.

checklist.item: Keep-outs: USB-C reachable bottom edge; LiPo zone; controller footprint; non-overlapping with keys
checklist.note: USB-C on bottom edge, LiPo + controller in dedicated strips; F5 clash=0.

checklist.item: Silk: key labels + version + half (L/R) legible in the render
checklist.note: All legends legible; 'thumbdeck-L/R v0.2' on inner edge; L/R in titles.

checklist.item: Envelope: within the stated phone-flank size target
checklist.note: 63x108mm per half, target <=64x112mm, flanks a ~160mm phone.
